recipes.name: Grandma Jane's Kicked Up Tomato and Cucumber Salad
ingredients_raw: freshly cracked five-peppercorn seasoning to taste

steps.text: Place the bacon in a large, deep skillet, and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain the bacon slices on a paper towel-lined plate. When cool, crumble the bacon into a large salad bowl. Reserve 1 tablespoon of bacon drippings, and let cool.

Mix the bacon drippings and mayonnaise into the crumbled bacon until thoroughly combined; stir in tomatoes and cucumbers. Season to taste with kosher salt, five-peppercorn blend, and cumin. Allow to chill for at least 1 hour before serving (overnight is better).

raw_recipe.description: Crumbled pepper bacon adds its flavor magic to this simple tomato and cucumber salad.

review.reviewBody: I used reduced fat mayonnaise and I added it 1/4 cup at a time until it was as creamy as I wanted. The cumin was optional, I opted out. The bacon drippings were a stroke of genius. This salad is IN-sane. CRAZY GOOD.

Delicious. I did not add cumin, personal preference, instead I added a little dill. Also substituted real bacon bits for ease of preparation at my lake house. Still this is a wonderful salad. Second time I made it I added a some macaroni and made it a pasta salad. This also came out great.

I’ve made this twice in the last week, trying to use up my cucumbers and tomatoes. Get first time, I used bacon, and it was great. The second time, I used prepared bacon crumbles and added the drippings from the first batch of bacon. It was good too. Both times, I added a thinly sliced Visalia onion and a handful of dry dill. It was a huge hit with my family!! I’ll definitely make this many more times!!

The reserved bacon drippings was genius. The cup of mayo not so much. I started with half the amount and that was plenty. Maybe even too much. With that being said, this is great recipe. Start with half of the mayo and go from there to suit your taste.
Omitted cumin, as per other reviews; added dill weed (dry), and probably used more than a TBLS. of bacon drippings, but oh, my- this really does taste like a BLT- soooooooo good!!!!

Deliciously different tomato and cucumber salad! To simplify it, I used a 4.3 oz. bag of real bacon bits instead of cooking bacon and crumbling it. Of course, I didn't have the 1 T. of bacon drippings to add but that just made the dish healthier. Omitted the cumin. Reminded me of a BLT with the mayo, tomato, and bacon flavors. Just be sure to de-seed the tomatoes and drain off as much liquid as possible before adding to the salad to minimize the wateriness of the dressing.

This was a wonderful way to change up the summer cucumber salad. I did change a bit to suit our tastes. I used half sour cream with half mayo since we aren't huge mayo lovers here. This was perfect for us for texture and creaminess. I skipped the cumin since my kiddos aren't fan and just used a little all purpose seasoning. This was a hit and we will be making it often in the summer.
Used turkey bacon. Didnt have cumin so I used some powdered chipotle pepper (smoked) to kick it up! This was yummy!!!!

Not too bad. WAY too creamy. If you don't like super creamy colelaw, potato salad, etc. (as I don't), I recommend cutting the mayo down by half. I thought the cumin was a really nice add. If you're not sure whether you'll like cumin, smell the cumin first - it tastes like it smells.
delicious! If you like a BLT sando you'll like this.
Excellent - made as written. Don't skimp on the bacon.
My husband and I loved it! We only wish we would have come across this at the beginning of our harvest!
made just like written and we loved it
I used crumbled bacon bits and added red pepper, omitted cumin. It was really easy to get my half plate full of veggies at dinner! Superb!
This is really good! Creamy with a nice kick, it was a pleasant way to use up our garden cukes and tomatoes. We will definitely be making this again!

Extremely yummy! We cut back a bit on the pepper since the bacon we had was very peppery and added a splash of hot sauce to the dressing. Even people who "don't like cucumbers" ate it and wanted seconds. A great way to use up all the garden surplus.
This was pretty good but I REALLY didn't care for the cumin, next time I will leave it out.

GLUTEN FREE, DAIRY FREE AND YUMMY!!!! AM-AZ-ING. Refreshing, and yes, reminds me of a salad version of BLTs. Can't taste a strong cucumber or tomato flavor. Just refreshing and satifying ( nice to have a filling vegetable side dish). I left out the cumin. I plan on making this many times to come.
